_readme: 待补音效清单。用 game-sfx-gen 技能生成：
去掉 --dry-run 实际生成（需 ELEVENLABS_API_KEY）。已存在的文件默认跳过，重做加 --force --only <name>。
音色家族：整套走国风实体乐器与自然材质（木、竹、玉、铜、丝弦、石、水），
不用西式电子合成音。同类时机共享材质，只换包络与音高，这样听起来才是一套。
priority 说明（字段仅供人读，脚本忽略）：
p0 = 修正现存错误音；p1 = 高频交互，最影响手感；
p2 = 养成与奖励回路的情绪峰值；p3 = 战斗信息补完；p4 = 锦上添花

sfx.name: gameover
sfx.text: solo soft bamboo xiao flute, only three slow descending sad minor notes fading into quiet silence, lonely heartbroken intimate close-mic, breathy fragile tone, completely dry and sparse, no percussion no drum no gong no erhu no guzheng flourish no bright bells no harmony no music loop no voice
sfx.notes: 失败要的是「难受」不是「气势」。忌大鼓/大厅/齐奏；用孤笛下行小调，空、静、心酸。备选：_gameover_b 玉碎、_gameover_c 古琴。

sfx.name: ui_click
sfx.text: clean soft UI button click, gentle polished jade bead tap, smooth and clear not scratchy, short bright tick without noise or grit, pleasant mobile interface feedback, dry studio, no rasp, no hiss, no plastic scrape, no wood thud, no reverb, no music, no voice
sfx.notes: 全局按钮。要清脆干净，忌沙哑/刺耳。禁止猛抬高频 EQ。

sfx.name: ui_back
sfx.text: soft clean UI back click, lower gentle jade tap, smooth muted tick, short and pleasant, no scratch no rasp no hiss, dry studio, no thud, no reverb, no music, no voice
sfx.notes: 返回/关闭。比 ui_click 低软一档，仍要干净。

sfx.name: ui_tab
sfx.text: light clean UI tab click, tiny soft glass ping, airy smooth and clear, very short, no scratch no rasp no hiss, dry studio, no thud, no reverb, no music, no voice
sfx.notes: 底栏/分栏。更轻更短，忌沙哑。

sfx.name: pet_levelup
sfx.text: bright jade chime with a gentle rising shimmer, warm and encouraging, clean short tail, no music, no voice
sfx.notes: 灵宠升级。现有 levelup.mp3 被连击音阶复用了，这里另起一条，避免养成反馈和战斗音混淆。

sfx.name: pet_starup
sfx.text: resonant bronze bell strike with rising jade shimmer and a soft airy swell, ceremonial and grand, medium hall space, no music, no voice
sfx.notes: 升星/觉醒。比 pet_levelup 更盛大更长，这是养成线最强的情绪峰值。

sfx.name: gacha_draw
sfx.text: silk scroll unfurling with a rising airy whoosh, building anticipation, ends unresolved without a hit, dry, no music, no voice
sfx.notes: 抽卡抽取瞬间。刻意不收尾、不落定，把落定感留给 gacha_reveal。

sfx.name: gacha_reveal_rare
sfx.text: bright golden bell burst with cascading jade sparkles and a warm sustained glow, triumphant reveal, medium hall space, no music, no voice
sfx.notes: 稀有揭示。与 gacha_draw 成对使用，构成「拉起—落定」。

sfx.name: reward_get
sfx.text: light coin and jade beads landing together with a short bright ring, satisfying and clean, quick decay, dry, no music, no voice
sfx.notes: 签到/任务/结算领取。现有 reward.mp3 已被战斗内命中与回血复用，UI 领取需要独立音。

sfx.name: chest_open
sfx.text: wooden chest lid creaking open then a bright cascade of jade beads and coins, warm and generous, no music, no voice
sfx.notes: 关卡宝箱开启。

sfx.name: shop_purchase
sfx.text: abacus beads clacking once then a short bright coin ring, decisive and clean, dry, no music, no voice
sfx.notes: 商店购买成功。算盘声给「结算完成」的确定感。

sfx.name: pet_skill
sfx.text: sharp silk whoosh rising into a bright jade chime strike, mystical pet skill cast, clear attack with short shimmering tail, dry with light air, no music, no voice, no reverb wash
sfx.notes: 沿用 xiao_chu/audio/pet_skill.mp3（★3+ 叠层）。施放主音是 skill.mp3；勿用 ElevenLabs 覆盖。

sfx.name: enemy_attack
sfx.text: crisp whip crack, instant snap, dry studio, no bass, no thud, no kick drum, no stone, no rock, no falling, no rumble, no whoosh, no voice, no music, no reverb
sfx.notes: 敌人打上。只要脆响，不要 kick/落石低频。交付是高通后的玩家裂纹+鞭/棍，运行时只加很轻的 combo 闪。

sfx.name: hero_hurt
sfx.text: very low muffled body thud, boxing glove hitting a heavy bag, dull dark and short, no treble, no scream, no grunt, no metallic ping, no voice, dry studio
sfx.notes: 英雄挨打垫层。比 enemy_attack 更闷更低，叠上去只加重量不加尖锐。

sfx.name: enemy_charge
sfx.text: low ominous rumble swelling upward with a tightening metallic tension, threatening build-up, ends without release, no music, no voice
sfx.notes: 敌人蓄力预警。信息价值最高的一条：玩家靠它决定是攒盾还是抢输出，光看动画容易漏。

sfx.name: gate_activate
sfx.text: heavy stone slab grinding shut with a resonant metallic lock snapping into place, forbidding and final, medium room, no music, no voice
sfx.notes: 硬闸门登场（五行阵盾/连锁盾/锋锐无效等）。要一听就懂「路被封了、得换打法」，不能只是又一个 debuff 音。

sfx.name: gate_broken
sfx.text: stone cracking apart then a bright metallic lock shattering with a clean release, relief and breakthrough, no music, no voice
sfx.notes: 满足闸门条件、伤害正常打出的那一下。与 gate_activate 成对，把闸门做成「解谜—破解」而不是纯惩罚。

sfx.name: phase_shift
sfx.text: deep gong strike with a dark rising swell and low earth rumble, transformation and dread, large hall space, no music, no voice
sfx.notes: Boss 跨血线转阶段。

sfx.name: shield_gain
sfx.text: very soft quiet protective whoosh, gentle air cushion forming, muted soft jade tap almost whispered, warm low shimmer barely there, smooth fade in and out, intimate dry studio, no sharp attack, no bright bells, no chime burst, no metallic ping, no music, no voice
sfx.notes: 获得护盾。要轻、软、不抢戏；忌亮叮/金属刺。

sfx.name: dot_tick
sfx.text: very short soft wet bubble pop, subtle and low, minimal presence, completely dry, no reverb, no music, no voice
sfx.notes: 中毒/持续伤害跳伤。每回合都响，必须做得很轻，否则几回合就令人烦躁。

sfx.name: orb_seal
sfx.text: dull stone slab sliding over a surface with a muted locking thud, oppressive and heavy, dry, no music, no voice
sfx.notes: 珠子被封印（含克属封印整片封色）。与 gate_activate 同材质家族，但更短更闷。

sfx.name: scene_transition
sfx.text: soft silk fabric sweep with a light airy tail, smooth and brief, no music, no voice
sfx.notes: 场景切换。要极轻，频繁出现的过渡音一重就烦。

sfx.name: error_denied
sfx.text: short dull wooden knock, flat and unresolved, slightly dissonant, completely dry, no reverb, no music, no voice
sfx.notes: 体力不足/条件不满足/操作无效。给「被拒绝」的明确反馈，避免玩家反复点。
